PrivacyPage.title: Privacy Policy & Terms of Use
PrivacyPage.subtitle: Information about your data security and legal rights.
PrivacyPage.intro: At RotaTurk, we value the privacy of our users. This text informs you about how your data is collected and processed.
PrivacyPage.locationDesc: RotaTurk uses your device's geographical location to create custom routes, run the 'What's Nearby' feature, and alert you about nearby points of interest. This data is only used while the app is active and processed anonymously.
PrivacyPage.cookiesDesc: We use essential cookies for core functionality (language preference, theme selection) and the unique visitor counter. Our visitor counter uses your browser memory to avoid counting repeated entries from the same device.
PrivacyPage.kvkkDesc: Your personal data (email, name, etc.) is only collected in sections provided with your consent, such as feedback forms or admin login. This data is not shared with third parties.
PrivacyPage.termsDesc: Route and place information provided by RotaTurk is for recommendation purposes. RotaTurk cannot be held responsible for any problems that may occur due to road conditions or other environmental factors.
PrivacyPage.contact: For your questions, you can contact us: rotaturktr@gmail.com
